Two diagnostic sites that indexed DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] (BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull for properties, MemberNeedsKey for fields) now get a null location instead, through a new GetPropertyIdentifierLocation helper and FirstOrDefault. New tests compile a defining assembly to a metadata-only image and run the analyzers and the generator against a consumer that uses a closed generic struct or record struct from it. README and MsgPack004 docs describe how such types are handled.
